$comment: English texts of data/regions.json (src/engine/overlay.js): the first region, Wiatrołomy, with its places, and the cards of the other regions (name, description, land), as the Combat tab shows them all; their places come in later stages. The name of a land is the same in all of its regions, as the casino groups the places of a land by it (src/engine/casino.js).

windfalls.name: Windfalls
windfalls.description: A belt of fallen trees on the edge of the wilds. Wolves, boars, deer and ravens, and deep in the thicket a wandering light and a storm-bringing Pwanetnik.

trait.name: Sacred Grove
trait.description: Rest between fights restores 5% more HP.

windfalls-edge.name: Edge of the Windfalls
windfalls-edge.description: A sparse copse by the first fallen trunks. Lone wolves and badgers, grass snakes in the long grass, and squirrels hurling pine cones from the branches.

fox-ravines.name: Fox Ravines
fox-ravines.description: Sandy ravines full of burrows. Foxes hunt here in pairs, martens leap through the trees, raccoon dogs take over the fox dens, and antlions wait at the bottom of sandy pits.

raven-hollows.name: Raven Hollows
raven-hollows.description: Upturned trees with their roots to the sky. Ravens nest on them, a tawny owl hunts at dusk, weasels dart between the roots, and a capercaillie displays in the clearing.

viper-heaps.name: Viper Deadfall
viper-heaps.description: Sun-warmed heaps of trunks. A viper basks on every stone, hornets buzz and stag beetles scrabble in the rotten logs, and a snake eagle circles above the deadfall.

boar-thicket.name: Boar Thicket
boar-thicket.description: The densest part of the Windfalls. Churned earth gives the boars away, deer slip between the trunks, a wildcat lurks in the undergrowth, and a black stork wades in the stream. Tusk marks show on the trunks higher than a man can reach.

stone-glade.name: Stone Glade
stone-glade.description: A clearing with a ring of mossy boulders, beyond which the true wilds begin. Stonelings, spiders, lynxes and packs of she-wolves led by an alpha wolf.

trait.name: Stone Circle
trait.description: The character at the front has 5% more armour.

backwaters.name: Overgrown Backwaters
backwaters.description: A valley where an old river lost its bed and spilled across the forest. Herons, beavers, catfish and crocodiles, and in the mist, drowned maidens and the water spirit.

trait.name: Reed Beds
trait.description: The character at the back of the line has 5% more dodge, hiding among the reeds.

peat-bogs.name: Peat Bogs
peat-bogs.description: Here the water has grown over with moss, and mists hang above the peat. Cranes, elk, leeches and sundews, and between the tussocks, will-o’-the-wisps, the kikimora and the bogman.

trait.name: Peat Fumes
trait.description: Poison lasts one turn longer, for creatures and characters alike.

black-bog.name: Black Bog
black-bog.description: The deepest part of the Peatlands, where the water is black as tar. Alders stand here on stilts of roots, the pillars of an old temple rise from the depths, and in a thicket of creeping willow lives the devil Rokita.

trait.name: Healing Mud
trait.description: Healing from skills and potions restores 5% more HP.

pine-dunes.name: Pine Dunes
pine-dunes.description: The first part of the Whispering Pines: dunes overgrown with heather and crooked pines. Further on the resinous forest murmurs, drifting sands bury and uncover old barrows, tar kilns smoke in the hollows, and beyond them lies a blackened burn, circled by the fiery Rarog.

trait.name: Scorching Heat
trait.description: Burn lasts one turn longer, for creatures and characters alike.

silent-wilds.name: Silent Wilds
silent-wilds.description: A dense spruce wilderness where it is always night and no birds sing, and every hunter waits in hiding for whoever walks last.

trait.name: Thorns
trait.description: Bleeding lasts one turn longer, for creatures and characters alike.

new-moon-depths.name: New Moon Depths
new-moon-depths.description: The deepest night of the Whispering Pines. The Moon-Eater ate the moon here, old pines rustle without wind, and out of the dark comes what should lie beneath the earth.

trait.name: Ground Frost
trait.description: Chill lasts one turn longer, for creatures and characters alike.
